summary: Frontend testing complete for Brightluxx header and homepage redesign. All features working: clickable navigation links, dropdown hover menus, glassmorphism effects, framer-motion animations, and Apple-style visual design.
passed_tests: Header has proper h-20 (80px) height with improved logo spacing
Products menu item is clickable and navigates to /products
Solutions menu item is clickable and navigates to /solutions
Technologies menu item is clickable and navigates to /technology
Tools menu item is clickable and navigates to /calculator
Dropdown menus work on hover for Products nav
Homepage hero section displays full-screen with video background
Hero has floating decorative icons (Cpu, Monitor, Sparkles)
Hero CTAs work: 'Get Quote' and 'Explore Products' buttons
Stats section shows 4 glassmorphism cards with backdrop-blur(40px)
Stats show cyan gradient animated counters (1500+, 500+, 800+, 12000m²)
Product categories section shows 4 icon-based glass cards (COB MicroLED, Transparent, Outdoor LED, Creative)
Featured products section displays 6 product cards with images
Why Brightluxx section shows 4 advantage cards with icons and glassmorphism
CTA section displays 'Let's Build Something Brilliant' with glassmorphism effects
Framer-motion animations work - 36 elements with transform styles detected
91 elements using cyan accent colors throughout site
All sections have proper data-testid attributes

GOOD: FadeInSection component uses useInView hook for scroll-triggered animations
GOOD: AnimatedCounter component animates numbers on viewport entry
GOOD: Cyan accent theme consistently applied (from-cyan-400 to-cyan-500)
GOOD: All interactive elements have data-testid attributes
context_for_next_testing_agent: Homepage redesign complete with: clickable nav links (Products->products, Solutions->solutions, Tech->technology, Tools->calculator), dropdown hover menus, glassmorphism cards with backdrop-blur(40px), framer-motion scroll animations, cyan accent color theme.
